name: Touch of chill
description: If you're the kind of tanker who remains cool and relaxed even in the most heated of battles, this animated paint is for you. It tells your enemies that nothing can unsettle you. You remain calm as a snowflake and deadly as a blizzard.
interestingFacts: Touch of Chill was available as part of a special holiday bundle created for the 2018-2019 New Year celebrations. Simultaneously, it was added to Containers permanently.
This paint was added to the game on December 21st, 2018.
The paint was available for purchase in a special offer for 59.90 USD, from December 21, 2018, to January 8, 2019.
Refrigerators can be bulky and expensive. A much more elegant solution is to store your food inside a tank wearing this paint.
